ko.title: Chimera Amp Matrix 개발기 Vol.1 — 세 가지 모드를 세 가지 라우팅으로 만들기까지
ko.excerpt: SpectralForge Chimera Amp Matrix의 첫 1.0 테스트 빌드를 만드는 과정을 기록한다. Classic·Dual·Matrix를 서로 다른 라우팅으로 분리하고, Matrix에 그대로 상속됐던 full-range EQ를 crossover-relative Band Tone으로 교체한 이유, Run #111의 첫 3-OS 성공과 최신 Run #112의 Windows UI 회귀 테스트까지 실패를 포함해 남긴다.

en.title: Chimera Amp Matrix Development Log Vol.1 — Turning Three Modes into Three Routing Architectures
en.excerpt: Documents the first Chimera Amp Matrix 1.0 test-build cycle: separating Classic, Dual and Matrix into genuinely different routes, replacing Matrix's inherited full-range EQ with crossover-relative Band Tone, reaching the first three-OS green/package checkpoint in Run #111, and recording the current Windows UI regression in Run #112 rather than hiding it.

de.title: Chimera Amp Matrix Entwicklungslog Vol.1 — Drei Modi als drei Routing-Architekturen
de.excerpt: Dokumentiert den ersten 1.0-Testbuild-Zyklus von Chimera Amp Matrix: Classic, Dual und Matrix werden als tatsächlich verschiedene Signalwege getrennt, der geerbte Full-Range-EQ von Matrix durch crossover-relativen Band Tone ersetzt, Run #111 erreicht den ersten grünen Drei-OS-/Package-Checkpoint und die aktuelle Windows-UI-Regression in Run #112 bleibt als Teil des Entwicklungsverlaufs sichtbar.
